notes: The Operating Model view could show you the model and measure its reach, but reading the whole story — what the number is, where it came from, what it leans on, and how it sits against the flow of opinion — meant assembling five panels in your head. This release does the assembly in prose, and calls the result what it is: INTERPRETATION. Nothing here is newly computed, predicted, or recommended; every sentence speaks a number produced elsewhere and carries that number's standing with it. - A third child under Operating Model — Model, Attribution, Interpretation — rendered as four readable sect
